faqLeft.q: What engine does the Range Rover Sport SDV6 use?
faqLeft.a: The Range Rover Sport SDV6 uses the 3.0-litre V6 diesel SDV6 engine, fitted across both the L320 (2005–2013) and L494 (2013–2022) generations.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Range Rover Sport SDV6 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover Sport SDV6?
faqLeft.a: The SDV6 is the only engine fitted to Range Rover Sport SDV6 models — there's no alternative engine code for this variant. Enter your registration and we'll confirm your exact spec.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Range Rover Sport SDV6 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR and gaskets as standard on every SDV6 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover Sport SDV6 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover Sport SDV6 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Range Rover Sport SDV6 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover Sport SDV6 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
